subject: general
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a series of form 1/(a×b) + 1/(b×c) + ..., Sum = 1/diff × [1/First − 1/Last]

The denominators are: (3×5), (5×7), (7×9), ..., (13×15).

Here, difference between factors (d) = 2, First factor = 3, Last factor = 15.

Sum = 1/2 × [1/3 − 1/15] = 1/2 × [4/15] = 2/15.

**∴ The correct answer is 2/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: 1/15 + 1/35 + 1/63 + ... + 1/195

⇒ 1/(3×5) + 1/(5×7) + 1/(7×9) + 1/(9×11) + 1/(11×13) + 1/(13×15)

⇒ (1/2) × [ (5−3)/(3×5) + (7−5)/(5×7) + (9−7)/(7×9) + ... + (15−13)/(13×15) ]

⇒ (1/2) × [ (1/3 − 1/5) + (1/5 − 1/7) + (1/7 − 1/9) + (1/9 − 1/11) + (1/11 − 1/13) + (1/13 − 1/15) ]

⇒ (1/2) × [ 1/3 − 1/15 ]

⇒ (1/2) × [ (5 − 1) / 15 ]

⇒ (1/2) × [ 4 / 15 ] = 2/15

**∴ The correct answer is 2/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Telescoping Series

A series where most terms cancel out, leaving only the first and last. Sum = 1/d × [1/a₁ − 1/aₙ] where d is the common difference between factors.

Factorization of Denominators

Look for patterns in denominators like n(n+d). In this case, they are products of consecutive odd numbers starting from 3.

General Term formula

The nth term of this series can be represented as Tₙ = 1/[(2n+1)(2n+3)]. Summing from n=1 to 6 gives the required result.
